answer: What keeps this honest is hand tremor frequency profile, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 554 pays 8864 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A trellis of doubt is healthy, a mirror of proof is required, and a sparrow of patience is the price of a clean panel. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
